description_en: Queries the tags bound to one or more ApsaraDB RDS instances
description_zh: 该接口用于查询一个或多个RDS实例已经绑定的标签列表
kebab_example: aliyun rds list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

INSTANCE: regular ApsaraDB RDS instance
CUSTOM: RDS Custom instance
CUSTOMDEPLOYMENTSET: RDS Custom deployment set
CUSTOMDISK: RDS Custom cloud disk
CUSTOMSNAPSHOT: RDS Custom snapshot
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型定义。取值：

INSTANCE：普通RDS实例。
CUSTOM：RDS Custom实例。
CUSTOMDEPLOYMENTSET：RDS Custom部署集。
CUSTOMDISK：RDS Custom云盘。
CUSTOMSNAPSHOT：RDS Custom快照
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. If a request does not return all results, you can use the token returned in the previous response to retrieve the remaining results
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的token继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The list of instance IDs. You can query the tags of multiple instances at a time. You can specify 1 to 50 instance IDs.
You must specify at least one of the ResourceId and Tag.Key parameters
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID列表。可以同时查询多个实例的标签，数量范围：1~50。
ResourceId参数和Tag.Key参数至少传入一个
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can specify 1 to 20 tag keys at a time. Empty strings are not allowed.
You must specify at least one of the ResourceId and Tag.Key parameters
fields.help_zh:
标签键。可以同时查询N个标签键，N的取值范围：1~20。不允许传入空字符串。
ResourceId参数和Tag.Key参数至少传入一个
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value corresponding to the tag key. You can specify 1 to 20 tag values at a time. Empty strings are allowed
fields.help_zh: 标签键对应的标签值。可以同时查询N个标签值，N的取值范围：1~20。允许传入空字符串
fields.name: value

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token. If a request does not return all results, you can use this token in the next request to retrieve the remaining results
NextToken.description_zh: 如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的token继续查询
